label: D2: rare transition a2 -> S1, late in the episode
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only when S1 is shown (in_state=1 holds 100% of the activation mass). 96% of the mass comes after the agent chose a2, so the trigger is the rare a2->S1 transition. The a1->S1 common case fires only weakly (4% of mass). The feature also depends strongly on how far into the episode the trial is: it never fires before about trial 10, and 97% of its mass is in trials 50-99. Adding ep_trial>=45 lifts dev F1 from 0.60 (rare a2->S1 alone, recall 0.93) to 0.81 (P 0.74, R 0.89, mass recall 0.94). All variables are observed at D2, so no future variables are used. The good state does not gate firing: restricting to good=1 or good=2 drops recall while precision stays the same. Excluding trials whose previous trial also reached S1 raises precision slightly but costs recall. Most false positives are repeated rare a2->S1 trials. Never active at D1, at GO, or when S2 is shown.

issues: Factual claims check out. Phase: all mass is at D2, with 0 activations at D1 and GO. in_state=1 holds 100% of the mass and S2 has 0 activations. in_action=2 holds 95.7% of the mass. ep_bucket 3 (trials 3-9) has 0 activations, and ep_bucket 5 (trials 50-99) holds 96.6%. a1->S1 has precision 0.014 and mass recall 0.043. No future variables are used.

Minor overclaim: 'Most false positives are repeated rare a2->S1 trials.' Within the predicate, cases where the previous trial was also a2->S1 make up about 6.2k of 31k predicted steps and have precision 0.59. That is roughly 2.5k of about 8.2k false positives (~30%), so they are a raised-rate subset, not the majority. Previous-trial-rare overall: precision 0.63, about 2.4k false positives.

The ep_trial>=45 cutoff is a little early. Within rare a2->S1, the firing rate ramps up gradually: precision 0.10 at trials 30-40, 0.15 at 40-44, 0.20 at 44-47, 0.37 at 47-50, 0.70 at 50-55 and 0.85 at 55-60. A cutoff at 48-50 is slightly better (test F1 0.814 at >=48, 0.812 at >=50, vs 0.805 at >=45). The difference is negligible and does not change the label.

No systematic false-positive or miss class remains. Within late rare a2->S1, precision stays at 0.75-0.83 across this trial's reward (future), next_stay, chose_good, good state, value, choice logit and start_high. Missed activations hold only 6.6% of the test mass and are scattered: weak a1->S1 common cases and early-episode rare cases.
Test check of the original predicate reproduces the reported scores: precision 0.742, recall 0.879, F1 0.805, mass recall 0.934.
